title: context-settings
description: profile/context.yaml (contracts/context-map.md section 8). Every key is optional.

ocr-languages.description: Tesseract language codes, e.g. eng, deu; each needs <code>.traineddata installed from the organisation's mirror

ocr-tessdata.description: folder of .traineddata files (absolute, or relative to the central repo); nothing is downloaded

explore-rounds.description: /build-context-map: rounds of explore, grade and fix per area before it is reported (default 3)

light-open-questions.description: gate 0: open questions a changed area may still have for light-track work (default 2); never a contradiction

question-ttl-days.description: baton context questions: days a question may stay open before it is OVERDUE for the Tech Lead (default 3)
